tableRows.crosswalk: The article reports a grouped count, not an individually named table row. Candidate names are not assigned per-lake NIFEP status; the source spelling Tadlak is retained as a possible spelling variant only.

limitations: Program activity and fishery enhancement are not a dated natural-fish survey; stocking can change assemblages and does not prove current wild presence.
The grouped seven-lake/Tadlak row does not assign activities to named individual lakes.
The six Rizal river sanctuaries are unnamed and cannot be crosswalked from this table.
Dagatan Lake San Antonio identity is unresolved against the Tayabas Dagat Dagatan and San Antonio Pagatan rows; no figure label is assigned to a scope lead.
No item-specific open license was found; the source remains internal research only.
